free_tier.stated: To set up Steam Cloud you must set the `Byte quota per user` and `Number of files allowed per user` options on the [Steam Cloud Settings](https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/cloud/) page in the Steamworks App Admin panel.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: 100MB maximum size for a call to ISteamRemoteStorage::FileWrite or ISteamRemoteStorage::FileWriteStreamWriteChunk
per_object_cap.notes: | 100MB | Maximum size for a call to ISteamRemoteStorage::FileWrite or ISteamRemoteStorage::FileWriteStreamWriteChunk |

retention.stated: Per-object-cap: 100 MB per FileWrite call (256 MB 'may result in a non-optimal storage endpoint'); per-object-cap: ~10,000 files per cloud save; the game must be launchable/owned for the user, and impersonating it blocks normal play during sync. Retention: indefinite. No expiry documented, but a developer can change quota or delist and the data can be evicted.
retention.notes: The Steam Client does the work of ensuring that the files are kept synchronized across all computers the user may be accessing.

egress.terms: No per-GB egress charge is published and the Steamworks page states no egress term; the Steam client keeps the cloud files synchronized across the user's computers and downloads them to a new computer before the game launches.

tooling: Steamworks SDK `ISteamRemoteStorage` (FileWrite, FileWriteStreamWriteChunk, FileReadAsync). Working wrapper exists: github.com/Fldicoahkiin/SteamCloudFileManager. 237 stars, Rust, Windows/macOS/Linux, '支持任意文件的上传、下载与删除' (arbitrary file upload/download/delete against any owned game's cloud). Design writeup: krutonium.ca/posts/using-steam-as-cloud-storage/.
chaining: You are able to share Cloud storage space between two app IDs by filling out the `Shared cloud APP ID` field.

reliability_note: Entirely undocumented by Valve; a developer lowering their quota can strand data, and files are re-downloaded into the local save folder on game launch. No public bans recorded.

notes: Quota is set by each game's developer as 'Byte quota per user' and 'Number of files allowed per user', 'enforced on each Cloud-enabled game, on a per-user-per-game basis'. No Valve-imposed total. Community-observed ceilings: 93 GB per game, ~10,000 files. Defaults are frequently tiny (a few MB to 1 GB).

extras.chaining_verbatim: One Steam account x every owned Cloud-enabled game with a large quota. At 93 GB/game, 12 games = ~1.1 TB; 100 games = ~9 TB. Multiply again by accounts. The lever is picking titles whose developers set 93 GB, not buying storage.
